pattern: のやら / ものやら / ことやら
aliases: no yara / mono yara / koto yara
purpose: Express uncertainty, puzzlement, or an unknowable amount.
keywords: Question clause + のやら / ものやら / ことやら
Where on earth did I put the key? I cannot remember.
I have no idea when it will ever end.
Who knows how many times I have explained it.
formation: Question clause + のやら / ものやら / ことやら
restrictions: Question words commonly precede it; ことやら can stress how much.
mistake: It often conveys emotion beyond a plain embedded question.
